title: No real player has ever reached king_slain, crown_broken, true_rest, or crowned_hollow. Across 105 receipted wins, 79 took the verses path and 26 the crown-debt path; 0 fought the king. The fight path and the two newer endings exist only in the validator's scripted proofs. Signpost the fight path (and the crown_broken / true_rest choices at the throne) so a blind player can find and choose them.
where: barrow throne / path signposting (warden class especially)

evidence.report: repo audit 2026-09-01, receipt tally over every file in reports/triaged
evidence.quote: endings decoded from receipts: blight_bound 43 + king_at_rest 36 (same verses path, renamed at 13:02), debt_paid 26, king_slain 0, crown_broken 0, true_rest 0, crowned_hollow 0, no receipt 10
Balance verse path vs. silver-tongue path — reading verses was much harder (needed 9-11+ on d20 with only +2 bonus) than dialogue-based solutions

note: Hand-filed by the audit session. crown_broken and true_rest were added by the loop at 18:13/18:35, so only the last few waves could reach them; king_slain has been open all day.
